c74object.name: j.remote
c74object.digest: Link a UI object to a node
c74object.description: j.remote keeps a UI object and a node (a parameter, message or return) showing the same value. What comes in is sent to the node as a command in the unit of the unit attribute; changes of the node come out of the left outlet as values and out of the middle outlet as set messages for UI objects that understand them. The node's answer to the remote's own command is not shown again, and dragging a UI object while a ramp runs stops the ramp.

objarg.name: address
objarg.description: Relative to the model (or to the model of the view) of the patcher, or absolute.

method.name: bang
method.digest: Ask the node for its value
method.description: A bang is sent to the node as a command.

method.name: int
method.digest: Send a number to the node
method.description: An integer is sent to the node as a command.

method.name: float
method.digest: Send a number to the node
method.description: A float is sent to the node as a command.

method.name: list
method.digest: Send a list to the node
method.description: A list is sent to the node as a command.

method.name: anything
method.digest: Send a message to the node
method.description: Any other message is sent to the node as a command; set value shows a value without sending it and address symbol sets the address.

method.name: dump
method.description: The dump message answers address and the address out the rightmost outlet.

method.name: set
method.digest: Show a value without sending it
method.description: The set message shows a value in the UI object (out of both outlets) without sending it to the node.

method.name: address
method.digest: Set the address of the node
method.description: The address message binds the remote to another node.

attribute.name: address
attribute.description: Relative to the model or view of the patcher, or absolute.

attribute.name: unit
attribute.digest: The unit of the UI object
attribute.description: The unit the UI object works in; empty means the node's own.

attribute.name: active
attribute.description: An inactive remote neither sends nor shows.

attribute.name: freeze
attribute.digest: Keep node changes from the UI object
attribute.description: A frozen remote shows nothing to the UI object; the UI object can still send.

attribute.name: highlight
attribute.description: Accepted so that old patchers load; it has no effect.
